what: Only the center slide stands at full size while the side slides shrink to .75× in a photo strip (2.75 slides on wide screens·1.5 on narrow) that advances endlessly one slot every 4 seconds. When advancing, the new center slide grows with .3s ease and the old one shrinks. Pressing or dragging a side slide brings it to the center

options.per: Number of slides visible on wide screens, default 2.75
options.per-sp: Number of sections visible on narrow screen, default 1.5
options.gap: Gap between sections (px), default 0 — the empty space around each shrunken section becomes the gap
options.scale: Next-card size, default .75 (also via css variable --fx-scale)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Length and curve of size change (via style), default .3s ease
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Swiper container (.swiper-container or .swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) — not needed if data-fx is put directly on the panel

note: Works with any Swiper 5 (.swiper-container) or 6 and above (.swiper). Photo corner radius (25px · phone 10px) is up to the consuming css

from.where: index.html activity photo strip (.gb-gallery — original Swiper 5.4.1 .list-gallery: loop·autoplay 4000·1.5→2.75 slides·centeredSlides·slideToClickedSlide, side slides scale(.75) transition all .3s ease)
